snippet.title: The People Profiles
snippet.description:
Established in 2018 by Edwin Elliott, The People Profiles was the first long-form independent documentary channel on YouTube. With detailed, politically neutral, meticulously researched scripts, all written by qualified and award-winning historians, narrators and video editors with years of experience in both video production and film. The team at The People Profiles prides itself on being the gold standard for attention to detail, accuracy, quality, as well as unbiased, fair and factual biographies of famous and infamous people in history.

As of 2026, all People Profiles scripts are written, narrated and edited by human beings and our thumbnails are based on real paintings, statues and photographs of each historical figure, to give you the most accurate image of them possible. 

"All human history essentially comes down to biography." Edwin Elliott

snippet.title: History In Seconds
snippet.description:
Welcome to HISTORY IN SECONDS – your go-to place for everything about the British Royal Family. 

Here, we dive into the fascinating world of royals, from headline-making scandals and closely guarded secrets to stunning royal jewellery, grand weddings, and day-to-day royal life. 

Whether it's the drama behind palace walls, the stories of King Charles, Queen Camilla, Prince William, Kate Middleton, Prince Harry, or Meghan Markle, or the timeless beauty of royal fashion and history, you’ll find it all right here. 

We cover royal events, love stories, controversies, and even lesser-known facts that bring the monarchy to life in a fresh and engaging way. If you’re curious about the people behind the crowns or just love royal glamour and tradition, you’re in the right place. 

Subscribe and join a growing community of royal watchers who love staying updated, sharing opinions, and celebrating everything regal – past and present. New videos every week, so don’t forget to hit the bell!

snippet.title: Ancient Origins
snippet.description:
While many believe that we already hold knowledge of humanity's origins, our view is that there still exists a multitude of anomalies and mysteries in humanity's past that deserve further examination.

We therefore wish to foster an open community that is dedicated to investigating, understanding and explaining the origins of our species on planet earth. 

Our aim is to move beyond theories and to present a thorough examination of current research and evidence and to offer alternative viewpoints and explanations to those currently held by mainstream science, archaeology and religion.

snippet.title: 60 Minutes Australia
snippet.description:
60 Minutes Australia was first broadcast in February 1979. Founding reporters Ray Martin, George Negus and Ian Leslie quickly established the show as the destination for the finest television journalism.  

Today, 45 years later, 60 Minutes remains Australia's leading current affairs program. Award winning correspondents Tara Brown, Amelia Adams, Adam Hegarty, Dimity Clancey and Nick McKenzie investigate, analyse and uncover the issues affecting all Australians.
